instructions: Read the primary source in full. Preserve publication date/status, implementation and source URLs; for an arXiv paper, record its primary and cross-list categories from arXiv. A technically successful full-text fetch is not sufficient when tables, appendices, or other evidence needed for the five slots are missing; continue through the ordered official full-text routes and use the next route only to fill the missing primary evidence. Follow workflow v10 fixed-slot transport; do not send completed Markdown from Scheduled Chat.
selection_reason: arXiv一次要旨では隣接層のKV状態を深さ方向の低周波共有成分と高周波残差へ分解し、オンラインの軽量プローブで注意ヘッドごとに共有・残差・非圧縮を切替える。32K文脈でKVメモリ6.2GB、実効3.9倍圧縮、復号70.4 token/sを報告し、長文脈推論のメモリ帯域と容量を直接改善する。
title: FreqDepthKV: Frequency-Guided Depth Sharing for Robust KV Cache Compression in Long-Context LLM Inference
